name: kleros-skills
description: Kleros Skills — Knowledge for AI agents working with Kleros

scripts.eval:triggers: env -u EVM_PRIVATE_KEY -u CDP_API_KEY_ID -u CDP_API_KEY_SECRET -u CDP_WALLET_SECRET -u CDP_CREDS_PATH -u GATEWAY_URL claude plugin eval . --eval-dir test/evals --model sonnet --judge-model haiku --no-publish --threshold 0.8 --tag trigger --max-cost-usd 6
scripts.eval:behaviour: npm ci --prefix kleros-create-dispute/scripts && env -u EVM_PRIVATE_KEY -u CDP_API_KEY_ID -u CDP_API_KEY_SECRET -u CDP_WALLET_SECRET -u CDP_CREDS_PATH -u GATEWAY_URL claude plugin eval . --eval-dir test/evals --model sonnet --judge-model haiku --no-publish --threshold 0.8 --tag behaviour --max-cost-usd 20 --allow-tools 'Bash(npm --prefix * exec -- tsx *prepare-dispute.ts*)' Write 'WebFetch(domain:sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io)' 'WebFetch(domain:arb1.arbitrum.io)' 'WebFetch(domain:cdn.kleros.link)'
scripts.eval: npm run eval:triggers; t=$?; npm run eval:behaviour; b=$?; [ $t -eq 0 ] && [ $b -eq 0 ]
scripts.eval:pilot: env -u EVM_PRIVATE_KEY -u CDP_API_KEY_ID -u CDP_API_KEY_SECRET -u CDP_WALLET_SECRET -u CDP_CREDS_PATH -u GATEWAY_URL claude plugin eval . --eval-dir test/evals --model sonnet --judge-model haiku --no-publish --threshold 0.8 --tag trigger --runs 1 --max-cost-usd 3; t=$?; npm ci --prefix kleros-create-dispute/scripts && env -u EVM_PRIVATE_KEY -u CDP_API_KEY_ID -u CDP_API_KEY_SECRET -u CDP_WALLET_SECRET -u CDP_CREDS_PATH -u GATEWAY_URL claude plugin eval . --eval-dir test/evals --model sonnet --judge-model haiku --no-publish --threshold 0.8 --tag behaviour --runs 1 --max-cost-usd 5 --allow-tools 'Bash(npm --prefix * exec -- tsx *prepare-dispute.ts*)' Write 'WebFetch(domain:sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io)' 'WebFetch(domain:arb1.arbitrum.io)' 'WebFetch(domain:cdn.kleros.link)'; b=$?; [ $t -eq 0 ] && [ $b -eq 0 ]
